pages.text: Breaking a recognized ore replaces its normal block loot with matching rocks.$(br2)$(li)Regular ore: 1–4 rocks$(li)Deepslate and Nether ore: 3–6 rocks$(li)End ore: 4–6 rocks$(br2)Fortune and Silk Touch use the same ranges.

pages.title: Which Ores Count?
pages.text: Rock items are generated from registered block IDs containing $(thing)_ore$(). This covers vanilla ores and many modded variants, rather than every block a mod calls a mineral.$(br2)Each generated rock keeps a link to its source block. Names follow the source ore, so modded variants stay distinguishable.
